full_judgment: 10. We note at the outset that the pre-emption case was filed on 16-1-2007 4(four) months after the amendment of section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. Any application filed even one day after the coming into force of any law must be in accordance with the law which exists on the date of filing.
